attacks.claim: The record has no answer for a second non-conciliation record on the same dispute. The Supreme Court's social chamber holds that the six months of CPCA 504 run from the FIRST record, that a second record on the same dispute cannot be obtained and does not revive the right, and that the resulting inadmissibility is of public order. In the decided case the worker's first claim was declared inadmissible in form, a second claim was forfeited, and a third claim on a second record was quashed without remand.
attacks.verifierQuote: «يسقط حق العامل في رفع دعواه أمام القسم الاجتماعي، إذا أصبح محضر عدم الصلح الأول خارج أجل ستة أشهر.» «لا يمكن استصدار محضر ثان بعدم الصلح بخصوص نفس النزاع الذي تضمنه المحضر الأول.» The statute itself: «في أجل لا يتجاوز ستة (6) أشهر من تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم الصلح» [cpca 504 ¶1].
attacks.quoteRef: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1488919, decision of 07-10-2021, read on coursupreme.dz (reading cpca 504 ¶1 and 69 ¶1); cpca 504 ¶1
attacks.change: Added deadline d3 (forfeiture, interpretive as it rests on case law, so it declares warn; raisedBy courtOfOwnMotion; same counting as d1; basis b21, b22, b23, b54, b24, b26) running from the new proposed date slot earlier_nonconciliation_record_delivered_on when the new proposed slot earlier_nonconciliation_record is yes; added checklist k68; worked examples vex1 and vex2. d3 asks whether an earlier record exists whenever a record exists or is unknown, so the question sets of the earlier examples with such a record gain earlier_nonconciliation_record (no effect changed). d1 is kept as written (the statute's own rule).

attacks.claim: The record leaves open whether the judge raises the CPCA 504 forfeiture of his own motion (d1/d2 raisedBy "unclear", o2 grade C). The Supreme Court's social chamber answers it: the inadmissibility for a claim outside the six months is of public order and the judge raises it of his own motion under CPCA 69.
attacks.verifierQuote: «ويعد عدم قبول الدعوى في هذه الحالة من النظام العام يثيره القاضي تلقائيا طبقا للمادة 69 من ق إ م إ.» The statute: «يجب على القاضي أن يثير تلقائيا، الدفع بعدم القبول إذا كان من النظام العام» [cpca 69 ¶1]; cpca 504 ¶1 does not class the forfeiture.
attacks.quoteRef: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1488919, decision of 07-10-2021, read on coursupreme.dz (reading cpca 504 ¶1 and 69 ¶1); cpca 69 ¶1
attacks.change: Open point o2: why and its first reading now carry the Supreme Court's holding (case law, not the text; grade C kept, protective reading unchanged); k13 and k46 notes updated; d3 declares raisedBy courtOfOwnMotion. d1 and d2 keep raisedBy unclear: no statute says who raises it, and a deadline resting on case law is interpretive and could no longer declare the block the statute's own forfeiture carries. Example vex3.

attacks.claim: The record says no text states the sanction of a claim filed without a non-conciliation record, keeps a 'curable defect' reading open (o1), and only warns. The Supreme Court's social chamber states as a principle that the claim is not admissible before the social section without a non-conciliation record, and it raised the point of its own motion as a breach of a fundamental procedural rule, quashing without remand; a second decision (file 1340230) again raised arts. 19, 36 and 37 of Law 90-04 of its own motion and quashed without remand.
attacks.verifierQuote: «لا تقبل الدعوى أمام القسم الإجتماعي في غياب محضر عدم مصالحة.» «عن الوجه التلقائي : المأخوذ من مخالفة قاعدة جوهرية في الإجراءات.» (file 1158046); «وبذلك قاضي الدرجة الأولى بقضائه كما فعل يكون قد خالف قاعدة جوهرية في الإجراءات وعرض بذلك حكمه للنقض و الإبطال.» (file 1340230). The statute: «ترفق العريضة الموجهة إلى المحكمة بنسخة من محضر عدم المصالحة» [labour-disputes 37 ¶1], with no sanction.
attacks.quoteRef: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1158046, decision of 07-09-2017, read on coursupreme.dz (reading labour-disputes 33, 34 and cpca 504); Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1340230, decision of 05-03-2020, read on coursupreme.dz (reading labour-disputes 19, 34, 36, 37); labour-disputes 19 ¶1, 37 ¶1
attacks.change: p1 message now states the Supreme Court's inadmissibility, raised of its own motion; p1 interpretiveNote quotes the decisions; p1 stays interpretive and warn (the sanction rests on case law, so it may not block). Open point o1: why, first reading and protective reading updated; o10 why updated; k26, k27, k47 notes updated. Example vex4.

attacks.claim: Where a conciliation agreement was recorded, the Supreme Court treats an ordinary claim before the social section on that agreement as contrary to CPCA 504 and quashes without remand, and holds that requests not covered by the agreement are not admissible in the enforcement route. The record's n1 only says the case is 'outside' and that the lawyer should check what the agreement covered; it does not handle the common mixed petition (enforce the agreement and add other wage heads).
attacks.verifierQuote: «ينفذ اتفاق المصالحة بموجب أمر من رئيس المحكمة عن طريق الالتماس بعريضة من أجل التنفيذ في أول جلسة.» «لا تقبل الطلبات الجديدة التي لم تكن محل اتفاق المصالحة.» (file 1340230). The statute: «يأمر رئيس المحكمة الفاصلة في المسائل الاجتماعية والملتمس بعريضة ... التنفيذ المعجل لمحضر المصالحة» [labour-disputes 34 ¶1].
attacks.quoteRef: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1340230, decision of 05-03-2020, read on coursupreme.dz (reading labour-disputes 19, 34, 36, 37); Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1158046, decision of 07-09-2017, read on coursupreme.dz (reading labour-disputes 33, 34 and cpca 504); labour-disputes 34 ¶1
attacks.change: Boundary n1 message now says that the Supreme Court enforces the agreement only by the president's order, refuses new requests not covered by it in that route, and quashed a merits judgment founded on a record of conciliation; o7 why and k41 note updated (what the remaining part needs stays open, o7). n1 keeps its when (conciliation_agreement_reached yes) and warns. Example vex5.

attacks.target: doc1, p1, aex7, aex8, bex5, bex9, rex11
attacks.claim: doc1 makes the copy of the non-conciliation record required whenever the worker is not a civil servant, including when 19 ¶2 made conciliation optional (defendant abroad, bankruptcy or judicial settlement) and no conciliation took place. Article 37 requires the copy only of a record 'issued by the conciliation office as set out in articles 26 to 32'; when the optional step was skipped no such record exists.
attacks.verifierQuote: «ترفق العريضة الموجهة إلى المحكمة بنسخة من محضر عدم المصالحة الصادر عن مكتب المصالحة كما هو مبين في المواد من 26 إلى 32 من هذا القانون.» [labour-disputes 37 ¶1]; «يعتبر إجراء المصالحة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة السابقة اختياريا عندما يقيم المدعى عليه خارج التراب الوطني أو حالة الإفلاس أو تسوية قضائية من قبل صاحب العمل.» [labour-disputes 19 ¶2].
attacks.change: doc1.requiredWhen now also excludes the case where no conciliation took place (nonconciliation_record no) and an exemption of 19 ¶2 is true (defendant abroad, or employer bankrupt or under judicial settlement); with those facts unknown the document stays listed. doc1 why and basis (b2, b3 added) updated. Example vex6 (p1 none; doc1 gives no finding, which the runner cannot list).

attacks.claim: The record's quote of art. 19 ¶2 reads «عندما يقيم المدعى عليه خارج التراب الوطني», sourced tier 1. The Arabic Official Journal page prints «عندما يقدم المدعي عليه خارج التراب الوطني». The quoted wording, and its hash, are therefore not the published Arabic text; the meaning 'resides' is very likely right but rests on a correction (or on the French text) that the record does not state.
attacks.verifierQuote: Arabic edition: «يعتبر اجراء المصالحة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة السابقة اختياريا عندما يقدم المدعي عليه خارج التراب الوطني أو حالة الافلاس أو تسوية قضائية من قبل صاحب العمل.»; French edition of the same issue: «Toutefois, la procédure de conciliation, visée à l'alinéa ci-dessus est facultative lorsque le défendeur réside en dehors du territoire national ainsi que dans les cas de faillite ou de règlement judiciaire de l'employeur.»
attacks.quoteRef: Official Journal 1990 no. 6 (7 February 1990), Arabic edition, p. 242 (file A1990006.pdf, sha256 e93aaff0038034f51ad63f16228a55ce0cefed4f83d6f59af9f40670456c2594); Official Journal 1990 no. 6, French edition, p. 210 (file F1990006.pdf, sha256 9dcfd9ca5d4523dd196f2df142211c6b332f67d8566ad2e9feddb57a01c130a2)
attacks.note: The Arabic page does print «يقدم» (the adversary read it rightly); the French text of the same issue prints «réside», so b2's rule (the defendant resides abroad) is what the law says and stays. The store's wording of 19 ¶2 («يقيم») is not the printed Arabic: a request line asks the store to record the printed wording and the French check; the record's quote is the script's and is not edited here. The «يقبل» of article 25 (b46) is the printed Arabic too; not an attack target, not checked against the French.

attacks.claim: r1 and b40 carry only the provisional execution by law for wages of the last six months (art. 22 ¶4). The next paragraph of the same article lets the court order provisional execution without bond for the period beyond six months, which is the usual request in an unpaid-wages claim covering more than six months.
attacks.verifierQuote: «كما يمكن المحكمة عند النظر في المسائل الاجتماعية ان تنطق بالتنفيذ المؤقت دون كفالة فيما بعد ستة اشهر.»
attacks.change: Added statement b58 (labour-disputes 22 ¶5) and request r2 (provisional_execution, accessory, without bond, for wages and allowances beyond the last six months, at the court's discretion); k21, k58 and k59 refs and notes updated. Example vex7.

attacks.claim: The checklist notes oppose individual disputes to collective disputes 'governed by Law 90-02'. Law 90-02 is said to have been repealed and replaced by Law 23-08 of 2023 on the prevention and settlement of collective labour disputes and the exercise of the right to strike. Not checked on joradp.dz in this run.
attacks.verifierQuote: «المادة 90 : تلغى جميع الأحكام المخالفة لهذا القانون، لا سيما القانون رقم 90-02 المؤرخ في 10 رجب عام 1410 الموافق 6 فبراير سنة 1990 والمتعلق بالوقاية من النزاعات الجماعية في العمل وتسويتها وممارسة حق الإضراب، المعدل والمتمم.»
attacks.quoteRef: Official Journal 2023 no. 42 (25 June 2023), Arabic edition, p. 23, Law 23-08 art. 90 (file A2023042.pdf, sha256 a5f4a86d66e6bbbdf7f26bf6355712a555fc9ddc94196cd808935c41b02a2dbb)
attacks.change: Checklist k2 and k23 notes now name Law 23-08 (art. 90 repeals Law 90-02); Law 23-08 is not in the store: request line appended and open point o14 added (grade D until step 2 has read it twice). Boundary n3 is unchanged (it rests on labour-disputes 2 ¶1). Example vex8.

attacks.claim: The requiredWhen branch (record is yes and delivered before the petition date) makes the conciliation step 'required' and 'missing' in exactly the case where the record exists and was delivered before filing, which is the case where the step is done. It also fires the warning and the m1/m2 accepted means in the same case, so the step is marked required and satisfied together. n5 treats the same dates as the normal, valid case.
attacks.verifierQuote: «يجب أن يكون كل خلاف فردي خاص بالعمل موضوع محاولة للصلح أمام مكتب المصالحة قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية.»
attacks.note: requiredWhen only says when the step's timing is in play; the evaluator then reads the step's own slot: with the record yes and delivered before the petition, requiredWhen is true and the step was done, so p1 gives none (examples aex1, bex1, rex12). The step is never both required-and-missing there. With delivery on or after the petition's date requiredWhen is false and n5 warns, as 19 ¶1 «قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية» requires.

attacks.claim: p2 treats exhausting internal procedures as a prerequisite that warns for every claim ('always'). Its basis b7 says only that the worker 'may' refer the matter to the inspector. b5 likewise says collective agreements 'may' set internal procedures. b4 uses non-resolution only in the definition of the dispute. No quoted paragraph makes the internal grievance a condition of filing. Its slot internal_grievance_exhausted is also not among the declared slots.
attacks.verifierQuote: «في حالة غياب الاجراءات المنصوص عليها في المادة الثالثة من هذا القانون، يقدم العامل أمره الى رئيسه المباشر» [labour-disputes 4 ¶1]; «بعد استنفاذ اجراءات المعالجة الداخلية لنزاعات العمل الفردية داخل الهيئة المستخدمة يمكن العامل اخطار مفتش العمل» [labour-disputes 5 ¶1].
attacks.note: 4 ¶1 says «يقدم» (the worker refers the matter), and 5 ¶1 places the referral to the inspector «بعد استنفاذ» the internal procedure; whether that conditions the court claim is a reading, which p2 already carries as interpretive, warn-only, never block, with open point o4 and both readings. internal_grievance_exhausted is declared in slots and in proposedSlots.

attacks.claim: d2 downgrades an expired forfeiture from blockCleanExport to warn as soon as the plaintiff merely invokes force majeure. b55 says the forfeiture is lifted only by an order of the court president, and d1 covers only the case where no order lifted it. With the invocation 'yes' and the order 'no' or unknown, the forfeiture still stands, so a mere invocation should not remove the block.
attacks.verifierQuote: «... يترتب على عدم مراعاتها سقوط الحق ... باستثناء حالة القوة القاهرة أو وقوع أحداث من شأنها التأثير في السير العادي لمرفق العدالة.» [cpca 322 ¶1]; «يتم تقديم طلب رفع السقوط إلى رئيس الجهة القضائية المعروض أمامها النزاع، يفصل فيه بموجب أمر على عريضة» [cpca 322 ¶2].
attacks.note: 322 ¶1 excepts force majeure from the forfeiture itself; ¶2 sets how its lifting is asked. Whether a force majeure relied on is real is for the president, so blocking would decide it; d2 warns and its message tells the lawyer to check the proof and to make the request to lift the forfeiture. Same structure as the final periods record (d5, d9).

attacks.claim: The boundary says the record was delivered 'on or after' the petition date, but the condition uses only afterSlot, which is strictly after. A record delivered on the petition day fires neither n5 nor the p1 'before the petition date' branch. The message also says the delivery date is 'not before' the petition date, which contradicts the condition.
attacks.verifierQuote: «يجب أن يكون كل خلاف فردي خاص بالعمل موضوع محاولة للصلح أمام مكتب المصالحة قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية.»
attacks.note: In the rule language afterSlot is true when the slot's date is on or after the other date (DERIVER-GUIDE section 4), so a record delivered on the petition's day fires n5, and p1's beforeSlot (strictly before) is false that day. The condition, the telling fact and the message («لا يسبق تاريخ العريضة») agree.

attacks.claim: b18 states the immediate execution and the daily penalty but drops ¶2, which limits the penalty. The penalty is not enforced until a grace period of no more than 15 days has expired.
attacks.verifierQuote: «غير أن هذه الغرامة التهديدية لاتنفذ الا عندما تنقضي مهلة الوفاء التي لاتتجاوز (15) يوما.»
attacks.note: 34 ¶2 governs when the penalty fixed by the president's order is enforced, after that order; this module only routes an unexecuted agreement to the president (n1). Checklist k67 already answers this neighbour paragraph with doesNotApply and a note.

attacks.claim: b28 drops the opening proviso of art. 20 ¶1, which subordinates the jurisdiction of the social courts to art. 7 of the code of civil procedure. The court rule built on b28 therefore cites an unconditional jurisdiction.
attacks.verifierQuote: «مع مراعاة أحكام المادة 7 من قانون الاجراءات المدنية تنظر المحاكم الفاصلة في المسائل الاجتماعية فيما يلي :» [labour-disputes 20 ¶1]; «تلغى، بمجرد سريان مفعول هذا القانون، أحكام الأمر رقم 66 - 154 ... والمتضمن قانون الإجراءات المدنية، المعدل والمتمم.» [cpca 1064 ¶1].
attacks.note: b28 cites ¶1 whole, proviso included. The code the proviso names was repealed by cpca 1064 ¶1; the jurisdiction rules now in force are cpca 500 (b27) and 800 (b39, b56), and exit x1 already warns when a public body is a party, so the section rule is not unconditional.

attacks.claim: n1 fires on conciliation_agreement_reached = yes and calls the case 'outside' the claim catalogue. b14 covers an agreement on only part of the dispute, so a claim on the unresolved remainder remains an ordinary labour claim. The boundary should not treat a partial agreement as leaving the catalogue.
attacks.verifierQuote: «في حالة اتفاق الأطراف على كل أو جزء من الخلاف يعد المكتب محضرا بالمصالحة على ذلك.» [labour-disputes 31 ¶1]; «في حالة عدم تنفيذ اتفاق المصالحة ... يأمر رئيس المحكمة الفاصلة في المسائل الاجتماعية والملتمس بعريضة ... التنفيذ المعجل لمحضر المصالحة» [labour-disputes 34 ¶1].
attacks.note: A partial agreement is a «محضر بالمصالحة» like a full one, and 34 ¶1 sends its non-execution to the president: the agreed part does leave the ordinary claim, so n1 rightly warns. It only warns, and its message tells the lawyer to check what the agreement covered and what remains in dispute (open point o7).

attacks.claim: Only two accepted means are listed (m1 disagreement, m2 defendant's non-attendance). There is nothing for a case where the office struck the matter out for the plaintiff's absence. That produces no non-conciliation record, so the plaintiff has no record to attach under b20. The rules give no warning or advice for this common situation.
attacks.verifierQuote: «يجوز لمكتب المصالحة ان يقرر شطب القضية في حالة عدم حضور المدعي او ممثله المؤهل ...» [labour-disputes 28 ¶1]; «ترفق العريضة الموجهة إلى المحكمة بنسخة من محضر عدم المصالحة الصادر عن مكتب المصالحة» [labour-disputes 37 ¶1].
attacks.note: A striking-out yields no record of non-conciliation, so the lawyer answers nonconciliation_record no and p1 warns (asks first for the exemptions), which is the advice the text supports; checklist k8 says so. No accepted means can be added for it because no record results.

attacks.claim: The cited art. 508 opens with 'in the two cases', but b36 quotes and states only the first case, the refusal to carry out a conciliation agreement. The second case is omitted without any marker.
attacks.verifierQuote: «2 - حالة الامتناع عن التنفيذ الكلي أو الجزئي للاتفاق الجماعي للعمل، يكون فيه ممثلو العمال طرفا، وواحد أو أكثر من أصحاب العمل.»
attacks.note: The second case concerns a collective labour agreement with workers' representatives as party, outside an individual dispute (labour-disputes 2 ¶1); the narrowest paragraphs carrying n1's rule are 508 ¶1 and ¶2, as cited.

attacks.claim: From memory: art. 800 of the CPCA was amended by Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022 (arts 800 and 801 on administrative court jurisdiction). The ¶1/¶2 wording quoted and the x1 exit may be out of date. Check the current text of art. 800 and the replacing provisions.
attacks.verifierQuote: «المحاكم الإدارية هي جهات الولاية العامة في المنازعات الإدارية، باستثناء المنازعات الموكلة إلى جهات قضائية أخرى.»
attacks.note: The store already holds article 800 in the Law 22-13 wording, and b39 and b56 cite that wording (ledgerRefs cpca/law-22-13); the start-date question is answered in checklist k65 and x1 stays interpretive.

attacks.claim: From memory: Law 90-04 on individual labour disputes was amended by Law 91-28 of 21 December 1991, and the text of arts 19 and 24-36 may differ in the current version. Check whether a later amendment changed the conciliation time limits or the optional-conciliation cases that d1 and p1 rely on.
attacks.verifierQuote: «المادة الاولى : تعدل المادة 40 (الفقرة الثانية) من القانون المشار اليه أعلاه، كما يلي : " المادة 40 : يمدد الأجل المحدد في الفقرة الثانية من المادة 40 من القانون رقم 90 - 04 المؤرخ في 6 فبراير سنة 1990، المشار اليه أعلاه، الى غاية 30 يونيو سنة 1992".»
attacks.quoteRef: Official Journal 1991 no. 68 (25 December 1991), Arabic edition, p. 2654, Law 91-28 art. 1 (file A1991068.pdf, sha256 f9d1dc6a42e87bed52b98ca99aeda954b40dad75dc4ed83435dc00bbec72c327)
attacks.change: Not a correction of d1 or p1: open point o6 why and checklist k28 note now record that Law 91-28 amends only article 40 ¶2; a request line asks for the amended wording of article 40.
attacks.note: Law 91-28 has two articles; it touches neither article 19 nor articles 24 to 37, so d1 and p1 rest on the wording in force as far as this law goes. A later amending law was not searched (o6 stays grade D).

attacks.claim: The social section of the court hears this claim. | partly: The TEXT establishes jurisdiction over specified employment, training and apprenticeship disputes, but does not identify this claim as one of them.
attacks.verifierQuote: «2 - تنفيذ وتعليق وإنهاء عقود العمل والتكوين والتمهين،» [cpca 500 ¶3]; «– الخلافات الفردية للعمل والناجمة عن تنفيذ او توقيف او قطع علاقة عمل» [labour-disputes 20 ¶2].
attacks.note: The module applies to unpaid wages, a dispute on the performance of the employment contract, which both paragraphs name.

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which always, a prior step must have been taken. | partly: The TEXT describes internal dispute procedures and permits notifying the labour inspector after their exhaustion. It does not establish an unconditional prerequisite before every court claim.
attacks.verifierQuote: «في حالة غياب الاجراءات المنصوص عليها في المادة الثالثة من هذا القانون، يقدم العامل أمره الى رئيسه المباشر» [labour-disputes 4 ¶1].
attacks.note: As atk-2: p2 is interpretive and warns only; it states no unconditional prerequisite (open point o4 keeps both readings).

attacks.claim: The plaintiff is notified of the striking-out decision within eight days of the decision. | partly: The supplied paragraph does not identify the decision as a striking-out decision.
attacks.verifierQuote: «يجوز لمكتب المصالحة ان يقرر شطب القضية ...» [labour-disputes 28 ¶1]; «يبلغ المدعي خلال ثمانية (8) ايام من تاريخ اتخاذ القرار.» [labour-disputes 28 ¶2].
attacks.note: ¶2's «القرار» is the decision of ¶1, the only decision of the article; the store's frenchCheck mismatch on article 28 is noted by the reconciler and no step depends on b44.

attacks.claim: When worker is public servant is yes, the case leaves the ordinary courts (outsideCatalogue). | partly: The TEXT excludes specified public-service disputes from conciliation offices and assigns administrative jurisdiction according to the public parties involved. It does not establish that civil-servant status alone removes a case from the ordinary courts or places it outsideCatalogue.
attacks.verifierQuote: «ويستثنى من مجال اختصاص مكاتب المصالحة الخلافات الفردية للعمل التي يكون طرفا فيها الموظفون والأعوان الخاضعون للقانون الأساسي للمؤسسات والإدارات العمومية.»
attacks.note: x2 already says this: it is interpretive, warns only, and its note states that the texts name no court for the worker's status as such (open point o5).

attacks.claim: Before a claim in which nonconciliation record is no or nonconciliation record is unknown or (nonconciliation record is yes and nonconciliation record delivered on is before the petition's date), a conciliation attempt before the labour conciliation office must have taken place, except when: Conciliation is optional when the defendant resides outside the national territory; Conciliation is optional when the employer is bankrupt or under judicial settlement; Disputes of civil servants and agents under the statute of public institutions and administrations are outside the conciliation offices. | partly: The TEXT does not use the record's absence, unknown status, or delivery strictly before the petition date as conditions for requiring prior conciliation. It states a general requirement for individual labour disputes, with the stated exceptions.
attacks.verifierQuote: «... قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية.»
attacks.note: The general duty and the three exemptions are the text's; the record's conditions only test the duty's timing («قبل مباشرة أي دعوى قضائية») and whether the record exists, as atk-1.
